verdict.rationale: Isaac covers the individual stages with its own components. Real-world captures can be ingested via NuRec and Isaac TeleOp, Isaac Lab trains policies with imitation and reinforcement learning, GR00T models can be post-trained for specific embodiments and tasks, and Isaac ROS deploys AI inference on Jetson. However, nothing documents a connected pipeline that feeds fleet-collected data into training and pushes the improved model back to a fleet, so developers must stitch these stages together themselves. Missing for 10: documented loop from collected robot data to training, fleet-wide model deployment or rollout tooling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end workflow.
